messages:
harper: quick kickoff  we need a field-ready battlecard + webinar landing + a short SDR playbook. focus on three practical differentiators vs cloud AI platforms / LLM APIs / infra sellers. keep language customer-facing and <20s read.

lee: propose three short differentiators: 1) latency SLOs we can commit to under multi-tenant load, 2) token economics controls (batching, KV prefix cache, quantization guidance), 3) same API surface across hosted/dedicated/private so teams avoid rewrites.

toni: i'll convert those into 10-12 word soundbites for slides and SDRs. i'll also add a one-liner explaining when each claim matters (startup POC vs enterprise compliance).

harper: want a tiny bench tease we can show on the landing page (one stat). thoughts?

sam.k: suggest: "example: 28% lower $/token on 4k seqs in our internal bench (example workload)." mark as example and link to appendix for methodology.

lee: for rebut snippets vs competitors: keep them practical 
- vs cloud-managed endpoints: "Good for quick demos. At scale you need runtime controls and transparent unit economics."
- vs public LLM APIs: "APIs work for prototypes; they don't give deployment options or active cost controls for high throughput."
- vs infra vendors: "GPUs are necessary but not sufficient. You also need rollouts, tracing, and caching baked into the runtime."

toni: SDR reply templates (copyable):
- "Thanks! Want a 48hr focused bench vs your stack (latency or cost)? We can run it."
- "If compliance is a priority we pair you with an Enterprise SE + security early in the process."
- "We can show quick routing + fallback options to keep SLAs while lowering unit cost."

ravi: inbound form fields + auto-tag rules suggestion: fields: company, company_size, role, deployment_interest [Hosted/Dedicated/Private], bench_focus [Latency/Cost/Full], compliance_needs [HIPAA/SOC2/None]. rules: Dedicated -> tag: Dedicated_interest -> route AM + SolutionsEng; Private -> tag: Private_VPC -> route EnterpriseSE + Security; bench_focus==Cost -> tag: Bench_Cost -> route GrowthSDR + PM; compliance_needs!=None -> tag: Compliance_lead -> route Security + AE. add priority flag if company_size > 1000.

harper: can we include a short escalation script for SDRs when they hit "compliance"? want exact wording to avoid delays.

toni: draft escalation script: "Thanks — given compliance needs, I'll introduce our Enterprise SE + Security to scope a private deployment. Would you like to include any specific controls (KMS/HSM, VPC-only, air-gapped)?"

lee: good. also add a one-sentence objection handler for "global footprint": "Global infra is helpful; our smart routing + model fallbacks preserve SLAs while reducing unit cost across regions."

harper: timeline: toni to drop SDR playbook + slide soundbites by Tue noon, lee to add bench teaser + methodology note by Tue EOD, ravi to publish form + zap routing Wed AM, i'll assemble battlecard and PR Thu. ops-bot: please confirm webinar slot.

ops-bot: Reminder: webinar slot reserved for 2026-05-12 11:00 PDT. Recording and slides will auto-post to #events after session.

sam.k: :thumbsup: added slide placeholders in the shared drive (link in thread).

toni: :thumbsup: will post SDR playbook draft in the doc PR.

ravi: :thumbsup: routing rules drafted, will submit PR Wed morning.

harper: thanks team  i'll collate and push the battlecard PR when assets land. :rocket:
